title: Combat Enhanced
description: A lightweight combat‑focused modpack designed for fast, modern Minecraft battles. Includes curated mods that enhance weapons, mobs, and overall combat flow.
body:
## **Combat Enhanced**
This inncredible modpack adds an uncountable number of features that lets you fight mobs with a fantastic choice of weapons, doing it all while keeping Minecraft's core identity.

**Almost 100 swords?** Yes. **A choice of shaders for performance and for having visual outstanding scenes?** Definitely. **Multiple fancy player animations when fighting?** With the **Better Combat** mod, yes.

If you are looking for a modpack that is lightweight, stable, performance friendly and doesn't drift away from Minecraft's identity, here it is.

This modpack was made by the youtuber Vision - 
[YouTube Link](https://www.youtube.com/@Vision_Minecraft/featured)
